wireFormat.F32: 1 word, IEEE-754 bits (F32.bits): -0, subnormals and NaN payloads kept
wireFormat.String: code point count, then 1 word per Char code (<= 0x10FFFF)
wireFormat.Real: 2 words: bits(hi), bits(lo); never a binary64
wireFormat.adt: constructor tag word when the type has more than one constructor, then fields in declaration order
wireFormat.Maybe: tag word (0 None, 1 Some), then the value
wireFormat.request: op id selects the def; arguments in parameter order
wireFormat.response: status word (0 ok, 1 malformed request, 2 unknown op) then the result
wireFormat.refused: Nat, Cmp, Char outside String, closures, arrays, generics, recursive types (the generator fails loudly; none occur on the production surface)
